title: float-to-integer casts do not saturate like the reference interpreter
root_cause: x86 cvttsd2si yields INT64_MIN for out-of-range/NaN, while interp uses Rust saturating `as`.

title: indexing or field access through a global pointer uses the address of the global slot
repro: Define global p as ptr<u8>. Set p to syscall(9,0,4096,3,0x22,-1,0). Set p[0] to 65.
root_cause: storage_address(Load(GlobalAddr)) returns GlobalAddr without checking whether the global itself is a pointer.

title: hexadecimal/binary/octal integer literals are rejected
root_cause: expression number parser accepts decimal only.

title: English type grammar cannot express FnPtr field/parameter types
repro: Define struct C with cmp as fn(ptr<i64>, ptr<i64>) -> i64.
root_cause: parse_type handles ptr/array/named types only.

title: phrase dispatch is not type-directed across overloaded module declarations
repro: three modules declare Phrase: "emit <x>" for i64/f64/ptr<u8>; Return emit 42 + emit 3.5 + emit bytes_ptr("x").
root_cause: PhraseBinding lacks parameter types and match_phrase chooses by literal-word score/name only.

title: Core-7 MemCopy has no English statement form
repro: Copy 8 bytes from a to b.
root_cause: lower_core does not recognize a memcopy directive.

title: bare sentence-initial `first` is stripped as a discourse filler, corrupting an identifier
repro: first is ops.f(2, 3).
root_cause: strip_fillers removes listed discourse words even without a following comma.

title: pointer-to-pointer indexing reuses the address of the pointer slot instead of the loaded pointer
repro: argv[1][0] with argv: ptr<ptr<u8>>
root_cause: storage_address(Load(inner)) always returned inner, even when the loaded value itself is a pointer.

title: `Define local` of an unsigned type emits a signed zero literal
repro: Define local x as u8.
root_cause: declare_local always used ConstInt(0, Some(ty)) for integer types.

title: null literal is not context-typed and cannot compare against ptr<i64>
repro: Define local p as ptr<i64>. If p is not null and *p is 42.
root_cause: ConstNull always used its AST annotation (default ptr<u8>) instead of an expected pointer type.

title: inner-block assignment cannot shadow an outer variable with a different type
repro: x is 7. If true: x is 1.5.
root_cause: assign_text treated any visible name as an outer Assign instead of declaring a current-scope shadow when the type changes.

title: assignment to a global function pointer creates a local shadow, then the call loads the zero global
repro: Define global fp as fn(i64,i64)->i64. Set fp to function add. Return fp(6,7).
root_cause: shallow_type(FnAddr) fell back to i64, so assign_text treated the global as a type-changing shadow; expression lookup also preferred globals over locals.

title: identifiers named `size`/`align`/`half`/`square` are always parsed as operators
repro: Define function alloc taking size as i64 ... bump += size.
root_cause: parse_unary consumed operator keywords without checking that `of` followed.

title: equally typed duplicate Phrase declarations are silently disambiguated by name order
repro: two public modules both declare Phrase: \"emit <x>\" for i64; main calls Emit 42.
root_cause: match_phrase_typed sorted ties and picked the first candidate instead of returning a structured ambiguity diagnostic.

title: `Let us ...` discourse is treated as a computational TransferMove imperative
repro: Let us check how much we spent today.
root_cause: intent classification used the lexical verb `let` without recognizing the closed-class let-us construction.

title: generic functions cannot declare aggregate locals because zero initialization is module-scoped
repro: Define function wrap of T ...: r is Pair<T,i64>.
root_cause: declare_local synthesized a module-level zero global whose type still contained unbound generic parameters; added a Zero(type) expression lowered to zero rodata + MemCopy.

title: TransferSub accepted any preposition, so past prose like `We spent 200 rupees on food` executed
repro: We spent 200 rupees on food.
root_cause: supported_predicate checked only for any preposition instead of Source/Extent roles.

title: possessive/determiner-initial prose could be mislabeled as an imperative and rejected as UNSUPPORTED
repro: My mother cooked rice. / The shop was very busy because of rain.
root_cause: final imperative fallback ignored closed-class sentence-initial determiners/pronouns.

title: tokenizer slices two bytes from a 3-byte UTF-8 character
repro: file containing a BOM or curly quote
root_cause: two-byte operator lookahead used &text[index..index+2] without checking ASCII.

title: very long left-associative expressions overflow the stack during AST drop/typecheck
repro: Return 1 + 1 + ... (5000 operands)
root_cause: expression parser had no node budget, producing an AST deeper than the native stack.

title: deeply nested generic/array type syntax is unbounded
repro: array<array<...i64...>> nested hundreds deep
root_cause: parse_type recursed without a depth guard.

title: a noun subject that is also a lexical verb hijacks passive main-verb detection
repro: cash is 42. cash is increased by 11.
root_cause: first_word_hit accepted the first word even when followed by a copula/auxiliary.

title: numeric passive subjects make Link Grammar report `to` as the verb
repro: 1 is added to x. / 42 is added to x.
root_cause: main_verb_hit trusted clause.verb even when it was a preposition; added a be-copula-anchored verb scan.

title: break/continue/trap ignored trailing operands and surfaced as loop-context type errors
repro: continue 10 of x.
root_cause: control anchors immediately returned Exec without validating that the reserved word had no operands (VerbNet frames use continue as a verb).
